$comment: Context tiers. Every skill and command stays installed and invocable. 'core' entries keep their full description in Claude's skill listing (auto-matched every turn). Everything else is listed by name only (skillOverrides: name-only), so it costs a few tokens instead of a paragraph and is found through the toolkit-router skill + INDEX.md. Edit this list, then run: node scripts/generate-index.mjs --write
$comment_external: Skills this toolkit doesn't ship that should be listed by name only. Leave empty for skills synced from claude.ai (anthropic-skills:*) and for plugin skills: Claude Code applies skillOverrides to neither, so an entry for one does nothing. Turn synced skills off with syncClaudeAiSkills, plugin skills with /plugin.
